notes.title: Wholesome Games Celebration and new platforms announcement!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221913/f55bbe63086269668418b8d40148a1efd0b42ce8.png

We are happy to announce that Shishi : Timeless Prelude will be part of the Wholesome Games Celebration on Steam this week!

Lots of cozy and cute games will be on sale from August 15-21, don’t miss it! Here’s the link so you can bookmark it in advance: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames


New platforms?
That’s right! Shishi : Timeless Prelude is also coming to PlayStation, Xbox and Mobile later this year! We can’t wait to share more details! In the meantime, here’s the announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=P8-RUyqLbpg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Beach Episode coming soon!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43221913/ffe9dab73624851d8fd4b9f39a053404ebca596f.jpg

Enjoy a beach vacation with Elia in this upcoming Shishi : Timeless Prelude DLC, Beach Episode!

Includes :

New character : Elia (Beach)
New spell : Beach ball
New mode : Beach Episode

The Shishi : Timeless Prelude Beach Episode DLC will be available on July 11th on Steam and Nintendo Switch.
